name: RSVP System
description: RSVP form with name field and 2 event attendance checkboxes, submitting to Google Apps Script, with success/error feedback. Google Sheets as data store
evidence: Implemented lib/api.ts (submitRsvp, RsvpFormData, RsvpPayload, RsvpApiResponse with env guard and defensive JSON parse), components/rsvp/rsvp-form.tsx (client component: name field, 2 event checkboxes, client validation, idle/submitting/success/error states, retry on error), components/rsvp/index.ts public barrel. Replaced placeholder in rsvp-section.tsx with real RsvpForm. Apps Script contract and sheet column mapping documented in docs/product-specs/feat-004-rsvp-system.md. Verified pnpm lint --fix, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build on 2026-05-06.
acceptanceCriteria: RSVP form with fields: Họ tên (name) + 2 event checkboxes
Checkbox 1: Đi ăn ngày 8/6 dương lịch (23/4 âm lịch Bính Ngọ) — tiệc đãi khách
Checkbox 2: Đi đưa đón dâu ngày 9/6 dương lịch (24/4 âm lịch) — lễ thành hôn
Form submits via POST to Google Apps Script URL
Error feedback shown on failure with retry option
Form validates required fields (name required, at least one event checkbox)
Google Apps Script code provided in docs/ for deployment

eventDaiKhach.label: Đi ăn ngày 8/6 dương lịch (23/4 âm lịch Bính Ngọ)

eventThanhHon.label: Đi đưa đón dâu ngày 9/6 dương lịch (24/4 âm lịch)

content.validation: Name required. At least one event checkbox must be selected.

notes: Google Apps Script URL configured via NEXT_PUBLIC_APPS_SCRIPT_URL env var. Vietnamese labels. Light mode only.
